tags.feature: Sweeping Strike Gloves: Enemies take +15% total global damage from you if you have basic attacked them in the last 3 seconds.
Finishing Strike: Using an ability while all other abilities are still on cooldown grants it +25% total damage.
Final Strike Pendant: Using and ability while all other abilities are still on cooldown takes 2s off of it's cooldown (5s cooldown for this item).
Combo Dagger: After using an ability, gain +20% total basic attack damage for 2.5s.
Greater Combo Dagger: After using an ability, gain +35% total basic attack damage for 2.5s.
Swift Regeneration: +60% health regen if you haven't been hit in the last 2s.
Brief Respite: Heal 2% max health whenever you stagger a mini boss or boss.
Quick Strike Boots: Using an ability while all abilities are off cooldown grants that ability +25% total damage.
Synergy of the Damned: +10% health regen and 5% shield gain for 3s when hit, stacking up to 3 times.
Exhausted Posturing: Using an ability grants temp max health equal to 5x the ability's cooldown.
Conquerer's Form: Gain 35 Temp Max Health for 5s when you kill/assist kill an Elite or Mini Boss (up to 30 stacks).
Masochist Gauntlets: +3.5% total global damage for 3s when hit (up to 6 stacks).
Breastplate of Warding: Gain 3% max health as shields when you kill/assist kill an Elite or Mini Boss.

Orb Momentum: Health Orbs give +7% attack speed for 5s (up to 5 stacks).

Added Temp Health description to Almanac.

tags.balance_change: Slightly nerfed Lizard Healer Mini Boss max health and healing amounts.
Bosses now have +40% max health.
The max shields you can have is now 5000, and shields decay faster while above 2000.
Heals from allies now grant a 40% heal reduction on future heals from allies for 4s (this applies to enemy healers as well).
Ice Mage Ice Front damage was lowered from 225 -> 150, but now gives 2 charges back at a time.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where lava elementals could occasionally spawn on the forest tileset.

notes.title: Version 0.8.20 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.8.20 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Rune Affixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Health Orbs grant temp health for 15s.
[*] Health Orbs grant base health regen for 4s.
[*] Having any temp health grants base health regen.
[*] While full health, % of health regen is converted to shields.
[*] Collecting an orb detonates an area attack.
[*] Hitting an enemy has a 20% chance to summon a lightning bolt that damages and slows enemies.
[*] Casting an ability gives + attack speed for 3s after the ability ends.
[*] Dropping below 40% health deals area damage equal to a % of your missing health.
[/list]

[h2]New Item:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Undying Will: When you would have died, instead gain Undying for 2s (ONE TIME USE).
[/list]

[h2]Minor Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a few loading tips.
[*] Adjusted enemy spawns again to make Act I less challenging, especially in single player.
[*] Reapers now spawn slightly less often during the Soul Reapers modifier.
[*] Bosses have +4% base max health.
[*] Mini bosses start spawning sooner during boss fights.
[*] Gold gain values on runes were nerfed a bit.
[*] Intellect points now give 20 max health per point instead of 15.
[*] Barbarian Ancestral Strike 1 talent changed from -10% attack speed and 50% damage -> -5% attack speed and 75% damage.
[*] Barbarian Ancestral Strike 2 talent changed from -5% attack speed and 50% damage -> -2.5% attack speed and 75% damage.
[*] Barbarian Ancestral Strike 3 talent changed from 75% total damage -> 125% total damage.
[*] Barbarian Enraged Attack talent changed from +10% damage -> +20% damage.
[*] Barbarian Attack HP Regen talents each changed from 5 base hp regen -> 4 base hp regen and +4% hp regen.
[*] Barbarian Attack Speed talents each changed to also give +8% Battle Fervor radius.
[*] Barbarian Attack Shield talents each changed from +24 shields and -0.1s delay -> +2% max health as shields and -0.075s delay.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.8.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.8.15 Balancing Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Minor Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added basic German localization.
[*] Soul Reapers max health reduced by 3.5% and they now gives small rewards on death like normal enemies.
[*] Adjusted enemy spawns to make the jump from Act I to II less drastic.
[*] Adjusted leveling speed to give you approximately 1 more talent before fighting the Act I boss.
[*] Vampiric Mutation healing on enemies was reduced from 5% max health to 4% max health (lasts 5 seconds).
[*] Adjusted the Lizard Healer Mini Boss to pause more between heals to make him more manageable.
[*] Reduced Lizard Healer Mini Boss area heal from 75 + 2.5% -> 65 + 2.5% (triggers every .5s).
[*] Updated a few talent names and descriptions for clarity.
[*] Rage Low HP Damage talent global damage increased from .35% -> .45%.
[*] Rage Free Burst talent: changed free burst from every 5s -> every 4s.
[*] Rage HP Regen talent changed from 5s -> 6s and now gives triple regen from bosses as well.
[*] Axe Throw Extra Charge talent: removed the -1 pierce drawback.
[*] Axe Throw Haymaker: changed +25% throw range -> +1 pierce.
[*] Removed 20 weaker Barbarian AA talents to make it easier to build into the other ones.
[*] Barbarian AA Stun Chance 1 changed to: +15% damage, +20% medium stagger chance
[*] Barbarian AA Stun Chance 2 changed to: +15% damage, +10% medium stagger chance, +5% heavy stagger chance
[*] Barbarian AA Stun Chance 3 changed to: +50/100% total damage on medium/heavy stagger
[*] Updated Low Health Whirlwind Quest so Mini bosses count as 3 stacks, and the reward total % damage was increased from 15% to 20%.
[*] Lowered requirement for Fervant Axe Throw Quest from 16 kills to 12.
[*] Lowered requirement for Leap Restraint Quest from 100 kills to 80.
[*] Lowered requirement for Low Health AA Kills Quest from 18 to 15, and changed the Runic Defense chance from 5% to 8%.
[*] Changed the Basic Attack Burn reward to apply burn on all basic attacks instead of only during rage.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved a rare issue where the demon boss goes AFK during the fight.
[*] Improved a rare bug where enemies might get stuck in place.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.8.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.8.6 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Barbarian Rune Affix: +1.5% Total Global damage per missing Battle Fervor stack.
[*] New Barbarian Rune Affix: +0.75% armor per Battle Fervor stack when below 40% health.
[*] Added the current number of shields as a stat that shows to the right of the health circle on the HUD.

[list]
[*] Upgraded items now cost 10% more gold per level.
[*] Updated the Leap Gravity Well talent to pull from a 40% larger area at base and to pull larger enemies more effectively.
[*] Increased the shields gained from the Leap Shields CD talent from 200 -> 250.
[*] Reduced the added cooldown from the Leap Charges talent from 3s -> 2.5s.
[*] Reduced the added cooldown from the Leap Temp Health talent from 3s -> 2s.
[*] Reduced the damage increase from the Leap Piledriver talent from 90% -> 80%.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where rerolling runes could get disabled after use.
[*] Fixed a visual issue when trading an item at the green Shrine of Risk.
[*] Fixed an occasional issue where reviving a teammate didn't remove the orange beam VFX on them.
[/list]

notes.title: Fallen Worlds Early Access Release
notes.content:
[h1]Early Access is here![/h1]

After 4 years of working on Fallen Worlds, we are ready to start Early Access and get some community feedback! We still have a long way to go and tons of content to put in, and we want your input to polish it up. There is a 20% launch discount this week if you want to jump in and try the game, or if you prefer more content feel free to wait and see what we add to the game over the next year.

[h2]Current Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] 1-4 player co-op
[*] Procedurally generated maps
[*] 4 different worlds
[*] 2 playable characters
[*] Customizable ability colors
[*] Epic Boss fights
[*] Over a dozen different enemies
[*] Randomized enemy mutations
[*] Randomized shrine events
[*] Randomized act events and modifiers
[*] Randomized talent choices
[*] Upgradable items and runes
[*] Intellect point tree
[/list]

Of course, as an early access title the game still has a few bugs. If you run into any issues, please let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/x2aXAZQAhP]discord server[/url].

And a special thank you to everyone who has already helped us with play testing, it has been a huge help!

Sincerely,
Fallen Worlds Dev Team

[*] Fixed an issue where the host sometimes couldn't move after starting an expedition
[*] Added a sound for quest progression and quest completion
[*] Reduced the number of kills needed for the Low Health Whirlwind quest from 40 to 30
[*] Updated the actual names of each world
[*] Added statistics and high scores by character in the Almanac under the Characters section
[*] Added Rune Re-Roll and Rune Fusion tabs in the Rune Forge
[/list]

Rune Re-Roll: On each rune you can choose one affix to re-roll. You can re-roll it infinitely, but once you re-roll it once the other affixes are locked and cannot be re-rolled on that rune.

Rune Fusion: You can fuse together 3 unwanted runes to create a new rune. The new rune level, type, and rarity are randomly chosen from the sacrificed runes, but the rarity is also increased by one level.

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
[h2]Major Update 0.6.150 (Patch Notes)[/h2]


Added a new Quest system:
[list]
[*]  Get quests from shrines or the quest vendor
[*]  Quest Vendor: Each time you find a quest vendor you can pay him essence to get one of 3 random quests (the first time is free in each expedition)
[*]  Shrine of Valor: Fight an endless army for 45s to choose a quest from a list of up to 3 quests options
[*]  Added 13 new quests
[/list]

All new look and feel:
[list]
[*]  Revamped the UI and HUD
[*]  Added all new original soundtracks for each map
[*]  Added the advice giver to the starting area, who has tips on hotkeys and how to get started
[/list]

Balancing changes:
[list]
[*]  Revamped the Basic Attack talent tree to be stronger and share the same random pool as abilities
[*]  Revamped the Barbarian talents (120 unique talents now)
[*]  Enemy spawns during a boss fight now increase the longer the fight goes
[*]  Updated DoT (Damage over Time) effects to scale with ability damage
[*]  You now get 4 talent choices per skill point
[*]  Rezzing a teammate no longer slows you
[*]  Increased the number of enemies that typically spawn on Act 1
[*]  Nerfed enemy hound attack range slightly so they can't auto hit you when chasing in a straight line
[/list]

Map changes:
[list]
[*]  Added desert tornados on the desert map that damage and pull characters toward the center
[*]  Added volcanic meteors on the lava map that drop every 4s and light you on fire when hit
[*]  Normalized enemy spawns across all maps to balance experience gained for each map
[/list]

Other changes:
[list]
[*]  Streamlined networking so all abilities are synced on clients
[*]  Added hotkey binding for opening the expedition start menu (default N), so you don't have to run to the portal
[*]  Added a rune summary legend on the tooltip
[/list]

notes.title: Major Game Update
notes.content:
[h2]Major Update 0.6.77 (Patch Notes)[/h2]


Replaced stuns with a new Stagger mechanic:
[list]
[*]  Light Stagger interrupts minions
[*]  Medium Stagger interrupts minions and elites
[*]  Heavy Stagger interrupts all enemies
[*]  Any excess stagger level increases the duration, so a Medium Stagger on a minion lasts 1.5 seconds (instead of the normal .5 seconds)
[/list]

Added Light Stagger to Barbarian basic attacks and Leap impact
Added Medium Stagger to Barbarian Axe Throw and Rage
Added Light Stagger to Ice Mage basic attacks and Ice Crater break
Added Medium Stagger to Ice Mage Ice Front


Enemy elites and mini bosses have a small chance to spawn with a mutation, like:
[list]
[*]  Frenzied (orange): +25% movespeed, +50% attack/casting speed, -20% max health
[*]  Titanic (green): +35% size, +35% damage, +50% max health
[*]  Vampiric (red): -30% max health, hitting a player grants +5% max health regen for 5s
[/list]

Added 2 new Act Modifiers:
[list]
[*]  Speed Mania (all enemies are 15% faster... even the boss)
[*]  Gold Drought (-50% gold, +25% essence)
[/list]

Added 4 new shrines:
[list]
[*]  Shrine of Skeletons: Activate to fight a tough skeleton army (Guaranteed item if completed successfully)
[*]  Shrine of Mutation: Activate to fight an army of all mutated enemies (Guaranteed rune if completed successfully)
[*]  Shrine of Risk: Trade 1 chosen item or essence for 1 random item
[*]  Shrine of Divinity: Purchase 1 blessed item (+2 bonus levels) with essence
[/list]

Added 7 new items:
[list]
[*]  Skillful Leggings: +30% Damage while above 70% health
[*]  Masochist Helmet: +40% Damage while below 40% health
[*]  Brawler's Fervor: +30% Damage to enemies near you
[*]  Ranger's Sight: +40% Damage to enemies far away from you
[*]  Shield of Light Scratches: +12% Armor when above 70% health
[*]  Shield of Broken Bones: +15% Armor when below 40% health
[*]  Tactful Strike: +20% Ability Damage
[/list]

Added the Item Forge:
[list]
[*]  Players earn Item shards from defeating bosses
[*]  Item shards can be used to permanently upgrade items so they are more powerful when you find them in an expedition
[/list]

Tutorial difficulty has 1 shrine per act, all other difficulties now have 2 per act
Added a chance for two reapers to spawn at once when in a party, up to 100% chance with 4 players
Increased Barbarian whirlwind base damage from 25 -> 30
Reduced base essence received from scrapping runes by 50%
Added a Scrap All option to scrap all runes in the currently filtered list
Added some tutorial messages on tutorial difficulty
Added the Almanac to the main menu, which has lots of information on game mechanics and enemies
Added a Display Monitor option in video settings
Added a Cursor Size option in gameplay settings
Added an option to reset ability colors to default
Updated the player revival sfx
Updated visuals for enemy health bars
Updated vfx for rune, shard, and gold drops
Increased shield decay rate by about 50%
Increased rez finish sound volume by 30%
Increased reaper ability sound volume by about 20%
Moderately increased player turn speed
Your time to be revived by a teammate lowers by 3s each time you are downed, so you have 20s to be revived, then 17, 14, etc. (caps at 2s)
You no longer gain essence from teammates' kills when you are dead
Individual kills and assists are now tracked. Assists require a minimum % damage to count (2p: 40%, 3p: 30%, 4p: 20%)
Personal high scores are now tracked as well
Reset demo account progress to implement new statistic tracking
Bosses can no longer collide with players
Player armor is now capped at 90%
Fixed an issue where steam names didn't load correctly
Fixed an issue the gold gain stat was displayed incorrectly on clients
Fixed an issue where negative armor would display as 0% armor on HUD
Fixed an issue where the axe throw would sometimes visibly travel too far on clients

notes.title: Free Demo Release
notes.content:
[h2]FREE DEMO[/h2]

The free Fallen Worlds Demo will be available until release! The demo includes online co-op features, so try it out with your friends!

The demo includes a fraction of the full game's content, but it does show off the following:

[list]
[*] 1-4 Player games
[*] Ability Color customization
[*] Procedurally generated maps
[*] Rune collection and upgrades
[*] 90+ character talents
[*] Act modifiers
[*] Shrine events
[*] 3 difficulties
[/list]

The full game will have much more, including:

[list]
[*] More characters
[*] More Enemies
[*] 10 Difficulties
[*] Item upgrades
[*] Intellect Point Tree
[*] Selectable expedition modifiers
[*] Lore collectibles
[*] Steam achievements
[*] And much more!
[/list]
